#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date."""
import sys
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
tw = c.stringWidth(TITLE, "Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawString((width - tw) / 2, height - 280, TITLE)

c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line((width - tw) / 2 - 20, height - 300, (width + tw) / 2 + 20, height - 300)

today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
dw = c.stringWidth(today, "Helvetica", 16)
c.drawString((width - dw) / 2, height - 330, today)

c.save()
print("[1/2] Cover page written:", COVER, "| title:", TITLE, "| date:", today)

reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
num_pages = len(reader.pages)
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print("[2/2] Merged cover +", num_pages, "report pages ->", OUTPUT)
print("Done. Final document has", 1 + num_pages, "pages.")
PYEOF
echo "Script created for report.pdf with Annual Financial Report cover"
